messages:
marta: Heads-up — after yesterday's auth retry rollout I'm seeing a bunch of silenced logs and missing request IDs in sampleapp-prod. Not all requests, pretty intermittent.
ben: ugh. any repro steps or logs?
marta: quick paste: token refresh triggers retry, then subsequent logs look like `INFO user=123 action=call` with no req_id. Before retry we have `req_id=abcd1234` in the same trace.
sophia: can you paste the SDK version and our opentelemetry hook ordering? we recently landed a change in the auto hook init.
marta: SDK @ 2.8.1, sampleapp uses our express middleware. config snippet: ```js
// order in app init
app.use(authRetryMiddleware);
app.use(redwoodTelemetry.init()); // opentelemetry hook
app.use(requestLogger);
```
ben: that ordering looks suspect — authRetryMiddleware does a fetch + replay, might not preserve trace/req headers on retry. retry code strips `authorization` and re-injects, and I think it re-creates the request, losing the req_id header.
sophia: yep. current retry implementation reconstructs the upstream request and doesn't call `preserveHeaders(original)` because we assumed header sanitization was handled elsewhere. my bad.
alex: what's the impact? customer-facing?
marta: some prod traces show broken spans for auth retries — downstream services get new req_ids or none at all. Make debugging painful.
ben: minimal repro: call endpoint that forces 401 then refresh; watch stdout. i'll try a local repro with the sampleapp.
sophia: potential quick fix: in retry path add `Object.assign(newReq.headers, original.headers)` but we need to scrub auth tokens per policy. Also ensure `traceparent` and `x-redwood-reqid` survive.
ben: agree. we should also change our opentelemetry hook to register before auth middleware on sampleapp quickstarts so devs don't hit this by default.
marta: PR incoming? i'll attach failing log snippet from prod.
ci-bot: deploy 2026-03-22T18:04:12Z started for redwood-sdks/express@main :rocket:
ben: PR review of fix planned — will add unit for header preservation + e2e that simulates 401+refresh.
sophia: i'll also add a changelog note and a telemetry test asserting reqid propagation across retries.
alex: rolling patch to the sampleapp quickstart and create ticket to scan other SDKs for equivalent behavior (python/go).
marta: thanks y'all. leaving the prod logs attached in the ticket. :thumbsup:
ben: thanks — will ping when a canary is up.
